scope: Read-only authored mission planning, not gameplay results or original executable calls. No career, live state, outcomes, rules or original assets modified. Structured facts derived from the retail archive.
decoder: Direct little-endian decode cross-checked with bwdtool. BWD chunks start at payload+12. MTBL node anchor=0x5a+151*k including chunk header; kind=L-0x34, delay=L-0x0a, objective=L-5, dependencies=L-0x2a (C/S/F,node,table,pad), target=L+0x16, other table/node=L+0x1f/+0x21. NAVP payload: xyz+0, radius_m u16+24, class u16+26, shown i16+16, team i16+22. See src/bwd.c and src/mtbl.c. Times are authored delay seconds, runtime strict comparison can finish on the following integer second.
